{{Quote|Name's Deera Ulyette, Senate Special Liaison to the Hutt Cartel. I work with Hutts who are friendly to the Republic. Yes, they do exist.|Deera Ulyette|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Deera Ulyette''' was a [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] citizen of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She was sent by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] as a Special Liaison to the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. Working with [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] like [[Bareesh Fenn'ak Torill]] from her base in [[Deucalon Spaceport]], she asked a fellow Republic citizen to crush a major Imperial operation in the [[Network Security District]] of Nar Shaddaa.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
If the player is male and allied with the Republic, Deera is a potential romance option. She is also the starting point for the Nar Shaddaa bonus series.<ref name="TOR" />
